# Vendor API specs

`deno-deploy-openapi.json` is the OpenAPI spec for the **Deno Deploy platform
API** (the hosting provider's control-plane API), vendored for reference. It is
NOT the Congress.Trade app API — it was previously kept at the repo root as
`deno_openapi.json`, where it was easy to mistake for app documentation. The
app's own public and client-facing API is specified in
[`app/docs/openapi.yaml`](../../app/docs/openapi.yaml).
